# gpfield

`gpfield` is the spatial member of an agricultural-analytics R-package
orchestra. It does change-of-support Gaussian-process regression for
field and multi-environment-trial (MET) data: it smooths a noisy field
surface, predicts at a support different from the one observed (a point
process predicted as paddock-scale block averages, with the predictive
variance propagated through the support map), and – the part that
matters in practice – abstains when the data support or the estimated
spatial range cannot bear the requested prediction resolution, rather
than returning a confident wrong surface.

The Gaussian process is a self-contained exact solver in base R, so the
package takes no heavy external GP dependency and installs and checks
anywhere.

## Related packages

- [gstat](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=gstat) does variogram
  modelling and point or block kriging, including spatio-temporal
  kriging and simulation.
- [fields](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=fields) fits curves and
  surfaces to spatial data with splines and kriging, choosing smoothing
  and covariance parameters by cross-validation or REML.
- [GpGp](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=GpGp) fits Gaussian process
  models to large spatial and spatio-temporal data quickly with
  Vecchia’s approximation.

gpfield fits an exact Gaussian process, whose cost grows with the cube
of the number of observations, so it suits field trials rather than very
large datasets. It adds a typed refusal when the estimated range or the
data cannot support the requested prediction, a one-call smoother for
row-column trial layouts
([`gp_field_smooth()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gp_field_smooth.md)),
and output in the orchestra manifest that the other orchestra packages
read.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("max578/gpfield")
```

## What it does

- **Fit** an exact spatial (or spatio-temporal) GP with a
  squared-exponential or `Matern` covariance, hyperparameters estimated
  by marginal likelihood.
- **Change of support** – predict block (areal) averages from point
  observations, with within-block correlation propagated into the
  predictive variance, not averaged away.
- **Honest abstention** – a typed refusal with a machine-readable reason
  when the range or support cannot bear the request.
- **MET smoothing** – one call from a row-column trial layout to a
  smoothed surface.
- **Orchestra manifest** – emit a result in the federation’s shared,
  versioned, integrity-hashed contract so it composes with the other
  members.

## A minimal example

``` r

library(gpfield)

# A noisy field on a 10 x 10 plot grid.
set.seed(1L)
field <- expand.grid(row = seq_len(10L), col = seq_len(10L))
field$yield <- 3 + 0.3 * field$row + sin(field$col / 2) +
  rnorm(nrow(field), 0, 0.2)

# Fit the GP.
fit <- gp_fit(gpfield_spec(c("row", "col"), "yield"), field, seed = 1L)
fit
#> <gpfield_fit>
#>   kernel:      matern
#>   n training:  100
#>   length-scale (standardised): 4.34
#>   range (raw units):           34.31
#>   marginal var / noise var:    3.317 / 0.02171
#>   log marginal likelihood:     10.6

# Predict two paddock-scale block averages (change of support).
blocks <- block_support(
  lower = rbind(c(1, 1), c(6, 6)),
  upper = rbind(c(5, 5), c(10, 10))
)
gp_predict(fit, support = "block", blocks = blocks, seed = 1L)
#> <gpfield_prediction>
#>   support:   block
#>   locations: 2
#>   mean range: [4.725, 4.778]
#>   sd range:   [0.03812, 0.03812]

# Ask for a resolution the field cannot support: gpfield abstains.
gp_predict(fit, data.frame(row = c(1, 60), col = c(1, 60)))
#> <gpfield_abstention>
#>   scope:  gp_predict
#>   reason: range_too_short
#>   detail: query spacing 83.44 exceeds 1 x the estimated range 34.31; the field cannot be resolved this finely
#>     spacing = 83.44
#>     range = 34.31
#>     spacing_tol = 1
```

# Package index

## Model specification and fitting

Declare a spatial or spatio-temporal Gaussian-process model and fit it
to field or trial data by marginal-likelihood maximisation.

- [`gpfield_spec()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gpfield_spec.md)
  : Specify a gpfield Gaussian-process model
- [`gp_fit()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gp_fit.md) :
  Fit a gpfield Gaussian process to field or trial data

## Prediction and change of support

Predict the latent field at point support, or at a different support –
paddock-scale block averages with the predictive variance propagated
through the support map.

- [`gp_predict()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gp_predict.md)
  : Predict a gpfield surface, optionally at a different support
- [`block_support()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/block_support.md)
  : Describe a block (areal) support for change-of-support prediction

## Field and trial smoothing

The one-call path from a row-column multi-environment-trial layout to a
smoothed surface, and a colourblind-safe raster of it.

- [`gp_field_smooth()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gp_field_smooth.md)
  : Smooth a row-column field or trial layout
- [`gp_field_plot()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gp_field_plot.md)
  : Draw a smoothed field surface (requires ggplot2)

## Orchestra contract manifest

Emit a smoothed surface as the orchestra’s versioned, integrity-hashed
ensemble-manifest contract, and verify it.

- [`as_orchestra_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/as_orchestra_manifest.md)
  : Emit a gpfield result as an orchestra manifest
- [`orchestra_manifest`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/orchestra_manifest.md)
  : The orchestra ensemble-manifest contract (gpfield-side
  implementation)
- [`verify_manifest()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/verify_manifest.md)
  : Verify an orchestra manifest's payload integrity

## Abstention

The typed refusal returned when the data support or spatial range cannot
bear the requested prediction resolution.

- [`gpfield_abstention()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gpfield_abstention.md)
  : Construct a typed gpfield abstention
- [`is_gpfield_abstention()`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/is_gpfield_abstention.md)
  : Is an object a gpfield abstention?

## Classes

The S7 object hierarchy carrying an analysis end to end.

- [`gpfield_spec_class`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gpfield_spec_class.md)
  : A gpfield model specification
- [`gpfield_fit_class`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gpfield_fit_class.md)
  : A fitted gpfield Gaussian process
- [`gpfield_prediction_class`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gpfield_prediction_class.md)
  : A gpfield prediction at a requested support
- [`gpfield_smooth_class`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gpfield_smooth_class.md)
  : A fitted-and-smoothed field

## Package

- [`gpfield`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gpfield-package.md)
  [`gpfield-package`](https://max578.github.io/gpfield/reference/gpfield-package.md)
  : gpfield: Change-of-Support Gaussian-Process Regression for Field and
  Multi-Environment-Trial Data
